sourceText: User selected the proposed hard constraint: degraded fallback must mechanically bind fresh multi-host availability probe, must check canonical hosts codex/claude/agy, must reject single-host-environment when two or more independent hosts are executable, and DONE gates must not accept missing-probe degraded 3x1 unless explicit-human-approval is used.
normalizedOutcome: A user cannot record or finish with single-host degraded fallback based only on prose when codex/claude/agy availability proof shows two or more executable canonical hosts.
acceptanceClaim: The CLI records fresh canonical host availability proof and rejects single-host-environment degraded fallback with a clear diagnostic whenever two or more canonical host CLIs are executable/version-responsive.
